title: Black phosphorus-based nanoplatforms for cancer therapy: chemistry, design, biological and therapeutic behaviors
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00007B, Review Article

Ashkan Bigham, Manuel Serrano-Ruiz, Maria Caporali, Ines Fasolino, Maurizio Peruzzini, Luigi Ambrosio, Maria Grazia Raucci
Black phosphorus nanomaterials have opened new doors to cancer therapy. They can induce anticancer activities intrinsically (selectively) and/or with external stimuli (PTT, PDT, SDT, etc.) and are highly suitable for drug/gene delivery.
